words.name: Word index
words.description: One list of the words you know, are learning or ignore, built from all your cards and marks. Reading mode and the Subtitle extension use it.

word_data.name: Word frequency and level
word_data.description: Shows how often a word is heard in films and series and its estimated CEFR level (A1–C2), so you can learn the common words first. Uses a word list that comes with the app; no internet needed.

language.label: Language of the cards
language.description: Which language the words on these cards are in (e.g. en). Set it per deck; empty means unknown and those cards do not count as words.

known_interval_days.label: Days until a word counts as known
known_interval_days.description: A word whose card waits at least this many days between reviews counts as known. A word you marked yourself keeps your mark.

screen.title: My words
screen.lead: Type a word to find it; click it to see its meaning, its sentence and how well you know it.
screen.unassigned: {count, plural, one {# card has} other {# cards have}} no language: pick the deck's language in Settings so they count here too.

empty.title: Your word list is empty
empty.body: Every word you add lives here: its meaning, its line from the show and how well you know it. Add your first word from Add.

no_match.title: No “{query}” here
no_match.body: Check the spelling or pick another status.

detail.label: Word: {word}

say.new: You haven't studied this word yet.
say.learning: You're learning it: it becomes known as you study its card.
say.known: You know it: its card went up to {days} days between reviews.
say.known_manual: You said you know it; if it has a card, it's still asked.
say.ignored: You ignored it: it doesn't show up in reading or in the counts.

detail.rank_line: Number {rank} among the words heard most in films and shows
detail.no_level: No frequency data for this word.
detail.no_seen: You haven't caught it in a video yet.
